title: finish_interview result
description: The only terminal tool. Calling it twice returns finished:true with alreadyFinished:true rather than failing, so a duplicate call at the end of a session is harmless.

reason.description: Echoed back. On a forced finish this is the loop's reason, which may differ from what the model asked for.

alreadyFinished.description: True when the session was already in a terminal state before this call.

gradingQueued.description: Whether the session was handed to the grader. False on a detached MCP call, where nothing is persisted.
